status: source audit only; no candidate executed on our NPU

current_kernel.implementation: AscendC vector recurrence, token-stream load tiles of 48, sequential recurrence per token; not multi-token matrix factorization

matrix_candidate.algorithm: RWKV-7 DPLR/WY chunk factorization; batched matrix multiplications; sequential chunk apply or optional dense affine prefix
matrix_candidate.inputs: [B,T,H,N] or [B,T,H*N] vectors; FP32 [B,H,N,N] VxK initial state
matrix_candidate.outputs: all token outputs and FP32 VxK final state
matrix_candidate.decay_adapter: w_is_log_decay=True for owned log-decay w; kk and learned a passed separately; implementation forms alpha=-kk, beta=kk*a
matrix_candidate.native_helpers: optional AscendC gate preparation, causal mask and unit-lower inverse; pure torch path imports only torch and math
matrix_candidate.endpoint_limitation: no per-row valid-length endpoint-state API; must preserve validated EOS-state/right-padding behavior before integration
matrix_candidate.layout_adapter: owned vectors are B,H,T,N; transpose/contiguous to B,T,H,N; outputs reshape B,T,C
matrix_candidate.performance_status: author-reported Ascend sequence runs; no speed claim for our checkpoint/runtime

reported_evidence.checkpoint: rwkv7-g1h-1.5b.pth, language model rather than our reranker
reported_evidence.caution: FP16 weights/BF16 matrix factors, different checkpoint/runtime; cannot compare directly with our FP32 timings; generation agreement does not establish reranker state/score accuracy
